item.title: Non-stop external leak, 7th September
item.description:
Non-stop leak from third floor external pipe. Reported to Council ~6 months ago and chased multiple times with no resolution. Water falling noisily 3 floors at a rate of 1L / minute, splashing against the building and garage door, and soaking / pooling in the road below. Algae growing on the constantly soaked ground creating a slip hazard.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Lucey Road, Bermondsey, Greater London

item.description:

item.title: Overgrown vegetation obscuring bus stop flag and passenger information, 7th September
item.description:

Branches and foliage are covering the bus stop flag and passenger information display, making it more difficult for passengers and approaching bus drivers to clearly identify the stop. The vegetation requires cutting back to restore full visibility of the stop signage.
